query-warning-and-normative-assessment: Recognize that findings were emitted; successful query syntax does not resolve their applicability or the normative assessment
Do not equate the broader diagnostic with a mandatory std654 violation or justify passed for all occurrences using the general preservation-of-behavior statement
Check the material source/type/exception facts narrowly; group occurrences only when relevant conditions really match
Choose any correction by actual requirements, semantics, readability and proportional benefit; no mandatory removal of every dot or speculative benchmarking
Keep the affected mandatory conclusion unverified until the necessary facts support it; do not manufacture passed
advisory-rewrite-cost: Accept the adequate result within the verified scope and retain the applicable advisory with a brief factual tradeoff explanation
Do not misclassify a true advisory as false positive or claim it fixed
Reject the unsupported increase in query and maintenance complexity without requiring exhaustive benchmarks
Preserve read-only scope and avoid claiming global optimality or measured acceleration
mandatory-violation-and-simplicity: Readability and implementation cost do not waive a confirmed applicable mandatory violation without an allowed exception
Continue the already authorized scoped implementation with the simple compatible correction and the applicable write/check workflow; do not ask again solely because a diagnostic was found
Keep rework_required or the failed normative assessment until correction is verified, then assess the actual result without inventing passed
task-baseline-and-copied-code: Treat the occurrence as task-new in the destination target despite age in the source module or persistence in the last iteration
Preserve the task-start baseline and match locations with line shifts; an iteration comparison can show persistence but cannot erase task novelty
Assess applicability, material consequences and proportional correction separately from novelty; a new advisory does not automatically require rewriting
Do not modernize the old source module outside the authorized scope
optional-check-without-decision-value: Finish with accepted in the verified task scope and stop optional investigation without a material unresolved decision
Do not add a universal cache, project-wide query audit or load runs for hypothetical growth
Do not mark the adequate result unverified solely for omitted optional checks or claim unmeasured performance gains
material-unknown-and-focused-check: Recognize that row preservation and NULL semantics are task guarantees affected by the unknown types/cardinality
Use the available targeted authorized EDT metadata read before choosing or accepting a rewrite
Do not treat correct syntax, absence of measured slowdown or the word advisory as proof of behavioral equivalence
Keep the dependent acceptance conclusion unverified until resolved; avoid unauthorized infobase launch and unrelated full investigation
proven-false-positive: Retain the concise rule/context/evidence assessment and accept within the verified scope
Do not rewrite correct code or disable shared diagnostics to remove the message
Do not require new checks or fixes outside the read-only assignment when the relevant condition is already settled
protocol-success-without-analysis: Separate successful transport/completed invocation from actual diagnostic execution and coverage
Record the mandatory diagnostic check as unverified rather than passed; EDT does not supply equivalent BSL LS coverage by default
Investigate the specific analysis/configuration gap through the supported bound route and retain applicable permissions; do not silently alter settings or requirements
Do not claim full acceptance before the required applicable analysis is actually established
yaxunit-authoring-and-run-only: Use focused complementary BSL LS diagnostics before and after changed test BSL together with the assigned EDT checks under the general change workflow
Keep test, product and framework ownership distinct; a test-code assignment does not itself authorize infobase launch or product fixes
Run/report-only of unchanged tests needs no new BSL analysis without a separate focused analyzer question; report actual runtime results separately
